care.summary: Tree-like succulent with sword-shaped leaves; very low maintenance and excellent air purifier.
care.light: Full sun to partial shade; bright indirect light indoors
care.soil: Well-draining, sandy soil or cactus mix
care.fertilizer: Light; balanced fertilizer in spring and summer, monthly
care.toxicity: Mildly toxic to pets if ingested
common_issues: Brown leaf tips from low humidity or overwatering
tips: Wipe leaves to prevent dust buildup
Rotate plant periodically for even growth
